dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, are you OK? You look exhausted.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ər juː oʊˈkeɪ? juː ˈlʊk ɪɡˈzɔːstɪd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm exhausted. My workload has been crazy this month.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ɪɡˈzɔːstɪd. maɪ ˈwɜːrkloʊd hæz bɪn ˈkreɪzi ðɪs ˈmʌnθ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, and my manager is very demanding. He emails me at eleven at night and wants an answer right away.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ənd maɪ ˈmænɪdʒər ɪz ˈvɛri dɪˈmændɪŋ. hiː ˈiːmeɪlz miː ət ɪˈlɛvən ət ˈnaɪt ənd ˈwɑːnts ən ˈænsər ˈraɪt əˈweɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's not OK. You need some boundaries.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈnɑːt oʊˈkeɪ. juː ˈniːd sʌm ˈbaʊndəriz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know. I'd rather he didn't email me after work. But it's hard to say no to your boss.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. aɪd ˈræðər hiː ˈdɪdənt ˈiːmeɪl miː ˈæftər ˈwɜːrk. bʌt ɪts ˈhɑːrd tə ˈseɪ ˈnoʊ tə jʊr ˈbɔːs.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Talk to him. Tell him you'd rather he sent emails during the day.
dialogue.reading: ˈtɔːk tə hɪm. ˈtɛl hɪm juːd ˈræðər hiː ˈsɛnt ˈiːmeɪlz ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Maybe. I'd rather we talked about it in person.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi. aɪd ˈræðər wiː ˈtɔːkt əˈbaʊt ɪt ɪn ˈpɜːrsən.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good idea. Everyone here is overworked. We all need a better work-life balance.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə. ˈɛvriwʌn ˈhɪr ɪz ˌoʊvərˈwɜːrkt. wiː ˈɔːl ˈniːd ə ˈbɛtər ˈwɜːrk ˈlaɪf ˈbæləns.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: You're right. I'll talk to him tomorrow.
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈraɪt. aɪl ˈtɔːk tə hɪm təˈmɑːroʊ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And tonight, don't check your email!
dialogue.reading: ənd təˈnaɪt, ˈdoʊnt ˈtʃɛk jʊr ˈiːmeɪl!
